references.text: The contrast between accusation (Gen 42:14) and comfort (50:19) shows Joseph's transformation and God's sovereignty over human betrayal.
A narrative parallel showing the transition from hidden identity and accusation (Gen 42:14) to revelation and reconciliation (Gen 45:4).
Complementary perspectives on the same family crisis: Joseph's suspicion (Gen 42:14) and his father's despair over the loss (Gen 42:36).
